thread:
Maria G: hey team, we got reports of intermittent gRPC streaming stalls from a few GPU pods after the nodepool scale yesterday. streams open but no tokens after ~30s. logs show repeated "rpc: connection is not active" errors
Sam W: seeing same from the load test. p99 latency jumps and then steady hang. opened tcpdump on pod NIC, looks like lots of ICMP fragmentation-needed messages? not 100%
Kevin (netops): can you paste the tcpdump snippet? pkt sizes?
Maria G: here — pulled a short capture, truncated for brevity:
```
15:23:12.345678 IP 10.0.3.12 > 10.0.7.45: Flags [P.], seq 1:1601, ack 1, win 64240, length 1600
15:23:12.345680 ICMP 10.0.7.45 unreachable - fragment needed and DF set (mtu = 1400)
```
Sam W: aha — host sending 1600 bytes but path MTU 1400. CNI is vxlan (encap 50 bytes). looks like one end still thinks 1500 while overlay reduces usable MTU.
Olga (sre): do we have GSO/GRO enabled on the vxlan interfaces? that can cause large host segments which end up fragmented on the wire and break gRPC streaming when fragments are dropped
Sam W: checked quickly: on node-a `ip link` shows vxlan0 mtu 1450, but eth0 mtu 1500. `ethtool -k vxlan0` shows gso: on, tso: on, gro: on
Kevin (netops): our cloud provider ENI path clamps to 1400 for that AZ due to gateway config. so host-level offloads + overlay mtu clash = fragmentation/DF hit.
Maria G: reproduction steps I ran: heavy streaming workload -> gRPC long-poll -> after ~30s streaming stalls. tcp_retransmit_count increases.
Olga (sre): quick mitigations:
- enable PMTU probing: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1`
- clamp MSS at kube-proxy iptables on egress: `iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu`
- or disable GSO on vxlan: `ethtool -K vxlan0 gso off gro off tso off`
Sam W: I ran `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on a test node and the client recovered streaming after a couple of RTTs. not ideal cluster-wide though
Kevin (netops): long-term we should enforce consistent MTU in CNI config and make the CNI set interface offloads appropriately. also need to add AZ MTU to our infra inventory so new nodepools pick correct MTU at provisioning
Maria G: agree. for immediate rollback: I'm going to push a DaemonSet that clamps MSS and toggles PMTU probing; schedule to run for 2h then revert if stable.
Olga (sre): please also add a canary job that exercises gRPC streaming 1m windows after the daemonset rolls to validate end-to-end.
infra-bot: deploy started: mss-clamp-daemonset v2026-03-18 by Maria G -> canary nodes 2/2
Sam W: after deploy on canary, streams look healthy. will monitor p99 for 30m then roll to remainder
Kevin (netops): follow-up task: add mtu metadata to node labels and make cluster-autoscaler use it when picking AMI/ENI type. filed infra ticket INFRA-1427
Maria G: thanks all. postmortem note: overlay+host offload + cloud-path clamp = fragmentation + DF -> gRPC stream stalls. action items: daemonset rollback plan, CNI mtu enforcement, node image bootstrap tunables, infra ticket. :thumbsup:
Olga (sre): adding to incidents board. good catch on the ICMP frag-needed trace — saved debugging time
Sam W: TLDR for oncall: if you see gRPC streams hang, check `tcpdump` for "fragment needed" and then run `ethtool -k <overlay-iface>` to check offloads
Maria G: will close once infra ticket has ETA and we have a permanent rollout schedule
